newsitem.title: UK: Raytheon unit expands UK operations.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit expands UK operations.

text.p: Raytheon E-Systems, a unit of Raytheon Co, said it will expand its UK operations by establishing a new company to manage, design, develop, integrate and manufacture UK and non-UK defence related programmes.
The company said at the Farnborough Air Show that Raytheon E-Systems Limited ((RESL) will provide additional jobs to the 1700 people Raytheon already employs in the UK.

The initial focus of the new company will be its bid for the UK's ASTOR programme -- a new initiative of the British Ministry of Defence to develop a second generation battlefield surveillance and targeting system.
